title: eludite.debug.set_variable output
description: The changed row, as eludite.debug.variables lists it.

value.description: The new value as the debugger shows it (from the UI thread, before the adapter answers: the value asked for, with `pending`).

reference.description: Non-zero when the new value has members: pass it to eludite.debug.variables with this stop.

pending.description: Only from the UI thread, which never waits for the adapter: the change was sent and the windows show it when it is answered.

stop.description: The stop the change was made at.
